text: In an alternate history, Xi Jinping and Donald Trump meet on a windswept bridge where a map of new possibilities glows between them.
They craft bold ideas to unite rival tech cities into a shared network that could heal old quarrels and spark new trade routes.
Skeptics circle like storm clouds as they navigate the challenges with wit and courage, turning each setback into a step forward.
By the final page, the world stands at a hopeful crossroads where collaboration triumphs and a peaceful future begins.
